metadata.title: High-Contrast Chiaroscuro Portrait with Grunge Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic, high-contrast portrait of a woman where half the face is submerged in total shadow (chiaroscuro). The image uses a desaturated, warm-toned monochrome palette, featuring distressed, stencil-like gothic typography across the lower third and thin, handwritten-style text in the upper corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme contrast between deep blacks and bright highlights
Textured, distressed typography against smooth skin tones
Vertical split lighting dividing the subject's face
Lower-third horizontal text placement anchoring the composition
coreInvariants: Hard-edged shadow line on the face
Distressed/weathered texture on the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium close-up, filling the vertical frame from chest to crown.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The illuminated eye and the large, textured text across the chest area.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the illuminated eye, moves down the bridge of the nose to the lips, then drops to the bold horizontal text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the head and shoulders, emphasizing the subject's form.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone Sepia (Transition areas and hair texture)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between absolute black and blown-out highlights.
paletteRestrictions: No pure grays (must have warm tint)

letterConstructionRules: Lower-case display text with sharp, diamond-shaped terminals
Heavy vertical strokes with thin horizontal connectors
Significant distressing, speckling, and 'bleeding' effects on the edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'a' and 's' feature elongated, sharp descenders or spurs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between formal, heavy Gothic and informal, light handwriting.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp, angular gothic structure of the primary text.
Approximates the scratchy, handwritten quality of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast chiaroscuro portrait of a woman against a black background. Use split lighting so one side of the face is in deep shadow. Apply a warm sepia-toned monochrome filter. The subject should be wearing a dark, textured garment.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered line of lowercase gothic/blackletter text across the lower third. Apply a heavy grunge/distress texture to the letters so they look weathered and speckled. Add a small, thin, handwritten uppercase phrase in the top left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting split vertically down the face?
Does the primary text have a distressed, gothic appearance?
Is the color palette restricted to warm monochrome?

adjustableVariables: Degree of distressing on the typography
Sharpness of the shadow line on the face
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast shadow detail on the face
Ensure text texture matches the 'weathered' aesthetic
Verify the centered horizontal alignment of the main text
Confirm the absence of any color besides the sepia/cream tones
recipe.reuseFormula: Chiaroscuro Portrait + Gothic Grunge Typography + Warm Monochrome Palette
